name: Long Haul
design_intent: SPORTS calm court #3 (v8_sports_courts.md tier 1, SIZE variety): the LONG PITCH. v2 (WK-107 / WK-98 SP-04): re-cut from 3600x1900 to 3200x1800 so the WHOLE court, both goal back-walls included, fits the sports fixed framing (SportsMode.camera_framing = bounds; zoom = min(1920/w, 1080/h) clamped to PartyMatch.CAM_MIN_ZOOM 0.60 -> 3200x1800 is exactly 0.600, the view rect == bounds; geometry sits 60px inside each side, 130px below the top, 120px above the bottom). Still the WIDEST Rocketball court (post-to-post 2620px vs 2240 on the 2800 courts) and the TALLEST (1350px ceiling-to-floor vs 1140). NO hazards, NO powerup_spawners (SYM-6, SC-CALM-CLEAN). SYMMETRY (SC-SYM): every element mirrors about centre x=1600, twins at the SAME y. GRIND FIXES (SP-15 / SP-12, data = WK-98 M3 ball log tools/out/sports/logs/m3b.json): (1) the ball lives low (median 310px above the floor, 59% of samples under 500px) but the v1 goal mouth started 550px up (CENTER PITCH: 400), so corner scrambles under the net ground on; v2 mouth bottom is 440px above the floor (still the highest in the set) and stays the biggest mouth (340 tall). (2) the v1 mid-bumpers sat 960-1090px above the floor where the ball spent ~5% of its time; v2 STAGGERS two pairs: a LOW inner pair (x1090/1990, y1040..1150 = 410-520px above the floor, the ball's 350-630px traffic band) that deflects floor-skimming rallies and long kickoff blasts, and a HIGH outer pair (x725/2325, y450..570) that keeps a bank-shot target for the long arcs. The centre lane (x1210..1990) stays open. KICKOFF (WK-104 schema, team 0 slots; team 1 mirrored about x1600): ball (1600,850), every slot exactly 700px from it like the other courts; the ball sits 100px above mouth centre (not at it) so the lower 2v2 seat's straight run (915,996)->(1600,850) clears the low bumper's top by >= 37px. MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (Tuning: g 1600, trampoline 270 -> airtime 1.16s x air_drift_max 340 = 395px drift; spring-tier ref 480 -> 527px; head-bounce 1150 -> ~413px up): every kickoff seat is 700px from the ball (1.8 trampoline drifts) and the ball hangs at y850, ~400px above a bouncer's apex (centre y1250 measured) -> BOOST (legacy no-block placement: inner spawn x750 -> 850px, ball y905); centre -> far post face 1600 -> 290 = 1310px (3.3 drifts) -> BOOST to press, SUPER for a full-court power shot; goal mouth y780..1120 sits entirely above a bouncer's apex centre (1246) -> scoring AND keeping goal require FLIGHT; upper airspace y210..1200 (73% of the court height) is flight-only; low bumpers leave 52px over a bouncer's head (pass under) and their tops (y1040) need boost; high bumpers are flight-only. Full-width TRAMPOLINE floor (y1560) + bumper ceiling/walls/posts -> no standable ground (Pillar 2). Goal pocket: post column x200..290 with the mouth gap y780..1120, back wall x60..140; goal_zone just inside (centre-in-rect entry).
